title: Replication data and code: AI-use disclosure and within-author writing style in biomedical abstracts, 2014-2026

creators.name: Prappo, Tanzim Hasan
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Shahjalal University of Science and Technology

description: Replication package for a matched three-wave within-author study of AI-disclosing biomedical authors (2014-2026): all collection and analysis code, the frozen marker lexicon, audited disclosure data, identifiers and SHA-256 hashes for every text, per-text metrics, the pre-collection replication plan and all numerical results. Texts are re-fetched and verified with rehydrate.py.
notes: Code: MIT. Data: CC BY 4.0. Quoted disclosure sentences remain under their articles' licences.
